delta.description:
Delta is signed: positive adds bookable spots, negative removes free
ones. An absolute target would be ambiguous about what to do with the
spots already sold.

price_per_player_santim.description:
Santim values travel alongside the formatted strings so the client can
compute totals without parsing display text.

idempotency_key.description:
IdempotencyKey is included because a duplicate submission investigation
starts here: two payments with the same key are one retried request.

actor.description: Actor is absent for system actions.

payment_count.description:
PaymentCount tells an admin at a glance whether the customer has
submitted anything at all, which is the difference between chasing them
and chasing the bank.

and chasing the bank.

games_credited.description:
GamesCredited is how many games had spots returned. A booking on a game
that was itself cancelled credits nothing, which is correct: that game no
longer sells anything.

duration_minutes.description: DurationMinutes defaults to 60, matching the column default.

occurrences.description:
Occurrences > 1 creates a weekly recurring series, which is what makes
the slot bookable monthly.

abandoned_after_confirm.description:
AbandonedAfterConfirm counts bookings that were paid for and then
cancelled. It is the closest honest proxy for a no-show, because nothing
in this system records attendance -- the dashboard must label it as what
it is rather than as players failing to turn up.

price_per_player_santim.description:
Santim values travel alongside the formatted strings so the client can
compute totals without parsing display text.

affected_bookings.description:
AffectedBookings is how many live bookings covered this game. Their
owners have been notified; the bookings themselves are untouched.

affected_spots.description: AffectedSpots is the number of player spots across those bookings.

paid_bookings.description:
PaidBookings is how many of them were already paid for, which is the
number a person now has to settle a refund with.

automation_rate.description:
AutomationRate is the share of this method's decided payments that
cleared without a human, as a fraction from 0 to 1.

spots_released.description:
SpotsReleased is set on a rejection, reporting how many games had their
capacity credited back.

account_suffix.description: AccountSuffix is the payer's own account tail, present only for CBE.

verifier_result.description:
VerifierResult is the decision trail written by the worker: the outcome,
the payee check, the reasons, and the bank's own response verbatim. This
is the evidence the decision rests on, so it is passed through unedited
rather than summarized.

decision.description:
Decision is "approve" or "reject". A named decision beats a boolean in a
JSON body: "approved": false is far too easy to send by accident.

has_password.description:
HasPassword lets the app hide "change password" for Google-only
accounts rather than offering an action that cannot succeed.

automation_rate.description:
AutomationRate excludes payments still awaiting their first verification
attempt from the denominator. They have no outcome yet, and counting them
as manual work would make the metric dip every time the queue grows
rather than when automation actually degrades.

BearerAuth.description: Admin access token from /auth/login, sent as `Bearer <token>`.

info.description:
Dashboard operations for staff: the payment review queue, bookings, fields and games, users, platform settings, reports and the audit log.
Every operation requires an admin access token; a player's token is refused with 403, and tokens minted for the public API are not accepted here.
info.title: MatchUp Admin API

get.description: The append-only record of admin actions. action and target_type are matched exactly against historical names, so a renamed action stays searchable. There is no total: the client pages until a short page comes back.

post.description: Revokes the session behind the refresh token. Revoking a session that is already dead is not an error.
Revokes every refresh token issued to the caller, on every device.

Sets a new password and returns a fresh token pair. Other sessions are revoked; the returned pair is the one that keeps working. 409 when the account signs in with Google and has no password to change.

422.description: validation_failed: current password incorrect, or the new one is too weak

post.description: Exchanges a refresh token for a new token pair. Refresh tokens are single-use: replaying one that was already rotated revokes the whole session family and answers 401.
